scope.en: Authored RBC/neutrophil/platelet form study, not blood-smear statistics, measured specimen geometry or physiological motion. Intact and cutaway show the same authored cell. No original failed-blood replacement.
scope.zh: 人工建模的红细胞／中性粒细胞／血小板形态教学，不代表涂片统计、实测标本或生理运动。完整与剖切视图展示同一人工细胞；不替换失败旧稿。

technical.scope: Specified static export checks passed; no exhaustive self-intersection test. Reopening the sanitized baked source in Blender 4.3.2 reproduced the exact reviewed GLB bytes. Separately, prior retained procedural rebuild matched geometry/shading but not bytes; a later threads=4 procedural rebuild failed strict geometry equivalence on 4 meshes. Generic procedural reproducibility remains unverified.

visual.scope: Limited authored teaching-form readability: closed biconcave RBC, connected contained neutrophil nucleus, clearly labeled intact/cutaway and illustrative platelets. Not microscopy reconstruction.

anatomy.scope: Qualitative primary-reference screening only, not expert or clinical validation.

runtime.scope: No browser/consumer interaction or animation test.

limitations: Arbitrary illustrative size/color/granule choices; no measured ultrastructure or complete organelles.
Cutaway is a display device, not a physiological opening.
Historical procedural rebuild SHA differs; baked-source export reproduces reviewed GLB exactly; only exact reviewed canonical GLB is approved.

reproducibility.en: The saved baked Blender source re-exports the exact reviewed GLB. This does not make the historical generator deterministic: one retained rebuild matched geometry/shading but not bytes, and a fresh rebuild failed strict geometry equivalence on 4 meshes; cause unestablished.
reproducibility.zh: 保存的已定型 Blender 源文件可重新导出与已审阅 GLB 字节一致的文件。但历史生成程序并非已证明确定：一份保存重建仅几何／着色匹配而字节不同，新重建有 4 个网格未通过严格几何等价检查；原因尚未确定。
